# Закрытие фазы P1

> Не править руками: это генерируемый вид.

## Контракт фазы

**Контракт фазы (contract-first).** Потребляет: terminal P0 и текущий typed listing/run cursor ·
Производит: доказанные fresh stop conditions, resumable hard-cap, scope-preserving recovery и
exclusive execution lease backlog/delta · Границы: не меняет EIS filter registry, proxy/TLS trust,
request budget или procurement ingest semantics.

## Произведено

- P1.1 — Сделать fresh stop безопасным для суточной точности ЕИС: safe day-boundary stop contract, updated docs, negative multi-page regression and replay test. Closure: later same-day rows are persisted, next-day/previous-day boundary is deterministic, overlap produces no extra revision, no existing default-policy behavior regresses, all commands green.
- P1.2 — Сохранять fresh hard-cap как resumable incomplete outcome: resumable hard-cap outcome, one continuation route, operator docs and regressions. Closure: after first capped slice cursor points to the next block and run is not falsely complete; second slice resumes exactly there; only a proven stop completes; duplicate continuation does not double-process; commands green.
- P1.3 — Сохранить fresh scope и недренированный interval в backlog/delta recovery: typed recovery scope, no-drop durable interval behavior, updated seeder/docs only where contract requires, mismatch/dense/cap regressions. Closure: requests preserve fresh subject, every popped interval is proven drained or replaced durably, fresh `backlog_rescanned_at` remains null on incomplete debt, later resume consumes the remainder, commands green.
- P1.4 — Исключить concurrent execution одного backlog/delta run: additive lease migration/model/factory contract, scheduler guards, atomic lease API, two-process fault suite and docs. Closure: exactly one scanner enters per run; non-owner cannot mutate/complete; expired owner is safely replaced; cursor resumes without lost/repeated completion; backlog and delta schedules are non-overlapping; commands green.

# Закрытие фазы P3

> Не править руками: это генерируемый вид.

## Контракт фазы

**Контракт фазы (contract-first).** Потребляет: terminal P2 trusted lifecycle · Производит:
гарантированный download retry, truthful source/representation storage, автоматическую сверку
потерянных continuations и согласованные worker budgets · Границы: внешний live pilot и итоговый
verdict принадлежат P4; новый workflow engine/outbox не вводится без доказанного gap и D#.

## Произведено

- P3.1 — Дать due Discovered документам единый retry route и общий detail backoff gate: due selector/claim, unique download job, corrected detail backoff, scheduler integration, end-to-end due/future/dead-letter regressions and docs. Closure: a transient failed Discovered downloads after due without new revision; future retry dispatches nothing through every branch; one failed of many does not block peers; duplicate delivery creates no duplicate version/event; commands green.
- P3.2 — Сделать source/archive object write условием успешной версии: checked storage write contract, atomic finalization Action, source/archive fault matrix, same-hash healing and docs. Closure: false/exception never yields Downloaded/version/event; DB rollback leaves no half-finalized state; retry heals object-only/missing-object cases exactly once; source and archive paths share invariant; commands green.
- P3.3 — Применить storage truth contract ко всем prepared representations: shared writer/finalizer, all-strategy failure dataset, idempotent healing, job transition guard and docs. Closure: every false/exception/partial write leaves document non-Prepared and no phantom ready row; retry converges to one complete representation set; existing format behavior remains green; commands green.
- P3.4 — Замкнуть retryable analyses и потерянные DB→queue continuations: reconciler, aligned state/guards/selectors, atomic claims, fault-injection suite and lifecycle docs. Closure: real transient path automatically retries after due; both DB→queue kill windows recover; duplicate sweeps yield one job/materialization; excluded dispositions stay excluded; permanent failure becomes explicit terminal; commands green.
- P3.5 — Согласовать operation budget, worker timeout, retry_after, lease и shutdown grace: versioned budget matrix in config/docs, extended invariant tests, real-worker recovery script and exact observed logs. Closure: slow successful screening and representative OCR finish or checkpoint safely; near-deadline extraction does not start a call that exceeds reserve; SIGTERM/SIGKILL recover via P3.4; no concurrent duplicate; all timeout inequalities and commands green.
